---
title: "Coloured terminal output, pasted as it was"
date: 2026-10-21
tags: ["terminal"]
---
A test run copied with its colours keeps the raw ESC bytes, and a form feed
 or a  can ride along. XML 1.0 forbids all three, even escaped, so one
of them used to make every feed listing this post unreadable.

```
[31mFAIL[0m tests/unit
```
